patterns.description: The slide is a chart/data-visualization template with a title, a large chart image, and placeholder metric labels and values.
The left side contains two repeated metric label/value pairs, suggesting reusable metric cards.
The donut chart area has a central value and label plus two percentage labels around the ring.
Fixed branding logos appear in the bottom-left and bottom-right corners.
Top and bottom connector groups are off-canvas decorative rules rather than editable content.

constraints.description: The chart visual is provided as a raster image object rather than a native chart object, so chart data is not directly editable through chart slots.
Branding logos are fixed images and should be preserved rather than replaced.
Off-canvas decorative connector groups are structural decoration and should remain unchanged.
